---
name: Lesson problem
about: A lesson has a mistake, an unclear explanation, or a check that is wrong
title: "[Lesson] "
labels: content
---

**Lesson** (for example `javascript/11-array-methods`)

**What is wrong?**
- [ ] A fact is incorrect or outdated
- [ ] The explanation is confusing
- [ ] A check rejects a correct answer
- [ ] A check accepts a wrong answer
- [ ] A question has more than one right answer
- [ ] A documentation link is broken

**Details**
Quote the text or paste your code. For a check problem, paste the exact code you wrote and the check message.

**Official documentation that supports the correction** (a link helps a lot)
